input.command:
cat > /tmp/pr-99-body.md << 'EOF'
## Summary

Root-cause fix for #99: the substrate compose stack collided on host ports 80/443 with the
pre-substrate-rename `portal` compose project, which was never torn down. That collision plausibly
interrupted Directus mid-bootstrap during the #97 deploy, before it seeded the admin user/role —
Directus's own install-check is gated on migrations having run, not on an admin actually existing, so
once that happens no restart/retry fixes it (confirmed by reproducing the exact scenario against a
local Directus container — see commit message).

Per discussion on the issue: no self-healing/auto-repair. I initially proposed a self-heal that
recreates the admin via Directus's REST API, but verified locally that's not actually possible (every
write endpoint 403s with zero users — Directus has no unauthenticated bootstrap escape hatch). Since
this looks like a one-time first-deploy bug, the agreed call is to fix the actual trigger (this PR)
and, separately, wipe the currently-broken live Directus state and redeploy clean — not build new
SSH-exec automation for something the trigger fix should prevent from recurring.

Also includes an already-in-progress, independent fix: `getSecretVersionOutput` for the admin
bootstrap password had no `dependsOn` on the secret's own `SecretVersion` write, so the read had no
ordering guarantee against it on a fresh deploy.

## Changes

- `substrate-bootstrap.ts`: cloud-init now removes any running container whose
  `com.docker.compose.project` label isn't this project's own before pulling/starting the stack.
- Extracted the cloud-init string-templating into a new pulumi-free `substrate-bootstrap-script.ts`
  so it's unit testable (the original file's top-level pulumi/GCP resource construction makes it
  unimportable from a plain vitest test).
- `secret.ts` / `people-hub.ts`: thread the `SecretVersion` resource through `randomSecret`'s return
  value and `dependsOn` it when reading the admin bootstrap password back.

## Test plan

- [x] `just ci` (build, format/lint, vitest) passes.
- [x] New unit test (`substrate-bootstrap-script.test.ts`) covers the cleanup-ordering and
      project-name-scoping logic.
- [x] Manually verified the actual cleanup shell logic against real containers on a local Docker
      network (a stale differently-labeled container holding a port gets removed; same-project and
      unrelated containers don't) — not something CI can exercise since it needs a real Docker
      daemon and simulated stale state.
- [x] Manually reproduced the original failure against a local `directus/directus:12.3.1` +
      Postgres container (wiped admin/role/policy rows while leaving migrations intact, restarted —
      confirmed the permanent 401) to confirm the root-cause hypothesis before fixing it.

Closes #99
EOF
